bugs.title: sync_brand_docs follows a replaced config symlink
bugs.evidence: After startup, replacing brandkit.config.yaml with a symlink redirects the tool's direct readFileSync/writeFileSync persistence and can overwrite magic_trick.md or another writable target.
bugs.resolution: Config loading and sync persistence now use identity-bound no-follow reads and atomic replacement; protected-target regressions pass.

bugs.title: Process-global index leaks brand data across server instances
bugs.evidence: src/index.ts stores currentIndex at module scope; starting server B overwrites the index read by live server A and its tools.
bugs.resolution: Every startServer invocation now owns a captured mutable index reference; concurrent-server and watcher-isolation regressions pass.

bugs.title: Preview lacks Host Origin and non-loopback authentication protection
bugs.evidence: src/preview/server.ts exposes brand pages without shared request policy while preview accepts arbitrary bind hosts.
bugs.resolution: Preview is loopback-only and applies the shared Host/Origin policy before all page and static routes.

bugs.title: init overwrites existing or symlinked configuration
bugs.evidence: src/cli/commands/init.ts checks only the brand directory then unconditionally writes brandkit.config.yaml.
bugs.resolution: Init now preflights both destinations, rejects unsafe entries, stages all content, and atomically commits or rolls back the config and brand pair.

bugs.title: startServer resolves before network listen succeeds
bugs.evidence: HTTP and SSE branches return immediately after app.listen; occupied ports resolve successfully then emit an uncaught EADDRINUSE.
bugs.resolution: HTTP and SSE startup now await listening, reject initial errors, defer watcher creation, and clean watcher/signal resources on failure or server close.

bugs.title: Manual publish version permits shell injection
bugs.evidence: .github/workflows/publish.yml interpolates workflow_dispatch version expressions directly into privileged shell scripts.
bugs.resolution: Publish scripts receive dynamic values only through env and a dedicated resolver accepts only strict SemVer from manual inputs or v-tags.

bugs.title: Publish executes mutable unverified latest binary
bugs.evidence: .github/workflows/publish.yml downloads and executes the latest mcp-publisher without a pinned version or integrity check.
bugs.resolution: Release tooling uses a fixed mcp-publisher release with verified per-architecture SHA-256 values, and every external workflow action is pinned to a full commit SHA.

bugs.title: Token formatting permits prototype pollution
bugs.evidence: src/formatters/token-formatters.ts indexes normal objects with unvalidated token types and names including __proto__.
bugs.resolution: Tailwind and W3C serializers use null-prototype dictionaries, preserving reserved-looking keys as data without inherited setters or properties.

bugs.title: Brand ingestion has no size or traversal budget
bugs.evidence: Scanner reads complete files synchronously and bounds neither file size, total bytes, file count, nor traversal depth.
bugs.resolution: A shared read policy now enforces bounded per-file, aggregate, canonical-file, lexical/canonical depth, and directory-enumeration budgets before returning content.

bugs.title: Docs generation can partially update its five-file set
bugs.evidence: docs command writes CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md and SKILLS.md before DESIGN.md and PRODUCT.md preflight can fail.
bugs.resolution: All five generated documents now share one complete preflight, staging, commit, backup, and rollback transaction.

bugs.title: Hot reload follows ignored and outside-root symlinks
bugs.evidence: Chokidar watcher retains followSymlinks true and does not apply normalized scanner ignore rules.
bugs.resolution: Watcher and scanner share one normalized ignore matcher, descendant symlink following is disabled, and residual symlink change events are filtered.

bugs.title: search_brand accepts negative and unbounded limits
bugs.evidence: Tool schema and runtime pass an unconstrained numeric limit directly to Array.slice.
bugs.resolution: Search schema and runtime require an integer from 1 to 100, default 20, and maintain a bounded top-k candidate set.

bugs.title: YAML aliases and cycles amplify or break serialized tool data
bugs.evidence: A 233-byte alias graph parsed by YAML/frontmatter expanded to 5,273,436 JSON bytes, while a self-alias produced a cycle that throws during JSON serialization.
bugs.resolution: Every production YAML load crosses a source-derived node/text/depth budget into an acyclic JSON-safe copy; unsafe frontmatter consumers fall back or skip with warnings.

bugs.title: Null font and asset manifest entries crash scanning
bugs.evidence: Valid YAML list entries with no value parse as null; scanner manifest loops dereference item.file and abort startup.
bugs.resolution: Font and asset manifests now validate mapping/array/item shapes and typed own data properties before access, warning and continuing on invalid entries.

bugs.title: search_brand query length amplifies response bytes
bugs.evidence: A 200 KB matching query across 100 hits generated a roughly 20 MB response because every snippet includes query.length bytes.
bugs.resolution: Search queries, snippets, sources, and final serialized payloads now have independent Unicode-safe character/UTF-8/byte ceilings.
